033/**
034 * Represents a group of {@link Serializer Serializers} that can be looked up by media type.
035 *
036 * <h5 class='topic'>Description</h5>
037 *
038 * Provides the following features:
039 * <ul class='spaced-list'>
040 *    <li>
041 *       Finds serializers based on HTTP <c>Accept</c> header values.
042 *    <li>
043 *       Sets common properties on all serializers in a single method call.
044 *    <li>
045 *       Clones existing groups and all serializers within the group in a single method call.
046 * </ul>
047 *
048 * <h5 class='topic'>Match ordering</h5>
049 *
050 * Serializers are matched against <c>Accept</c> strings in the order they exist in this group.
051 *
052 * <p>
053 * Adding new entries will cause the entries to be prepended to the group.
054 * This allows for previous serializers to be overridden through subsequent calls.
055 *
056 * <p>
057 * For example, calling <code>g.append(S1.<jk>class</jk>,S2.<jk>class</jk>).append(S3.<jk>class</jk>,S4.<jk>class</jk>)</code>
058 * will result in the order <c>S3, S4, S1, S2</c>.
059 *
060 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
061 * <p class='bjava'>
062 *    <jc>// Construct a new serializer group</jc>
063 *    SerializerSet <jv>serializers</jv> = SerializerSet.<jsm>create</jsm>();
064 *       .add(JsonSerializer.<jk>class</jk>, UrlEncodingSerializer.<jk>class</jk>) <jc>// Add some serializers to it</jc>
065 *       .forEach(<jv>x</jv> -&gt; <jv>x</jv>.calendarFormat(<jsf>ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME</jsf>))
066 *       .forEachWS(<jv>x</jv> -&gt; <jv>x</jv>.ws())
067 *       .build();
068 *
069 *    <jc>// Find the appropriate serializer by Accept type</jc>
070 *    WriterSerializer <jv>serializer</jv> = <jv>serializers</jv>
071 *       .getWriterSerializer(<js>"text/foo, text/json;q=0.8, text/*;q:0.6, *\/*;q=0.0"</js>)
072 *       .orElseThrow();  <jc>// Throws if no serializer matched the Accept header.</jc>
073 *
074 *    <jc>// Serialize a bean to JSON text </jc>
075 *    AddressBook <jv>addressBook</jv> = <jk>new</jk> AddressBook();  <jc>// Bean to serialize.</jc>
076 *    String <jv>json</jv> = <jv>serializer</jv>.write(<jv>addressBook</jv>);
077 * </p>
078 *
079 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
080 *    <li class='note'>This class is thread safe and reusable.
081 * </ul>
082 *
083 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
084 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/SerializersAndParsers">Serializers and Parsers</a>
085
086 * </ul>
087 */
088public class SerializerSet {

153      /**
154       * Installs the supplied {@link BeanStore} as the {@code overridingParent} of this builder's bean store.
155       *
156       * <p>
157       * Wraps the current {@link #beanStore()} in a fresh {@link BasicBeanStore} whose {@code overridingParent}
158       * is the supplied store, so test-time overrides win over the builder's regular bean lookups during
159       * construction-time reflective injection.  Passing {@code null} is a no-op.
160       *
161       * @param store The override layer.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (no-op).
162       * @return This object.
163       * @since 10.0.0
164       */
165      @Override
166      @SuppressWarnings({
167         "resource" // BasicBeanStore lifecycle is owned by the enclosing builder; closed externally when the builder is disposed.
168      })
169      public Builder overridingBeanStore(BeanStore store) {
170         if (store != null)
171            this.beanStore = new BasicBeanStore(this.beanStore, store);
172         return this;
173      }

175      /**
176       * Adds the specified serializers to this group.
177       *
178       * <p>
179       * Entries are added in-order to the beginning of the list in the group.
180       *
181       * <p>
182       * The {@link NoInherit} class can be used to clear out the existing list of serializers before adding the new entries.
183       *
184       * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
185       * <p class='bjava'>
186       *    SerializerSet.Builder <jv>builder</jv> = SerializerSet.<jsm>create</jsm>();  <jc>// Create an empty builder.</jc>
187       *
188       *    <jv>builder</jv>.add(FooSerializer.<jk>class</jk>);  <jc>// Now contains:  [FooSerializer]</jc>
189       *
190       *    <jv>builder</jv>.add(BarSerializer.<jk>class</jk>, BazSerializer.<jk>class</jk>);  <jc>// Now contains:  [BarParser,BazSerializer,FooSerializer]</jc>
191       *
192       *    <jv>builder</jv>.add(NoInherit.<jk>class</jk>, QuxSerializer.<jk>class</jk>);  <jc>// Now contains:  [QuxSerializer]</jc>
193       * </p>
194       *
195       * @param values The serializers to add to this group.
196       * @return This object.
197       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If one or more values do not extend from {@link Serializer}.
198       */
199      public Builder add(Class<?>...values) {
200         List<Object> l = list();
201         for (var e : values) {
202            if (Serializer.class.isAssignableFrom(e)) {
203               l.add(createBuilder(e));
204            } else {
205               throw rex("Invalid type passed to SerializeGroup.Builder.add(): %s", cn(e));
206            }
207         }
208         entries.addAll(0, l);
209         return this;
210      }
211
212      /**
213       * Registers the specified serializers with this group.
214       *
215       * <p>
216       * When passing in pre-instantiated serializers to this group, applying properties and transforms to the group
217       * do not affect them.
218       *
219       * @param s The serializers to append to this group.
220       * @return This object.
221       */
222      public Builder add(Serializer...s) {
223         prependAll(entries, (Object[])s);
224         return this;
225      }

262      /**

362      /**
363       * Returns direct access to the {@link Serializer} and {@link Serializer.Builder}objects in this builder.
364       *
365       * <p>
366       * Provided to allow for any extraneous modifications to the list not accomplishable via other methods on this builder such
367       * as re-ordering/adding/removing entries.
368       *
369       * <p>
370       * Note that it is up to the user to ensure that the list only contains {@link Serializer} and {@link Serializer.Builder}objects.
371       *
372       * @return The inner list of entries in this builder.
373       */
374      public List<Object> inner() {
375         return entries;

378      /**
379       * Sets the specified serializers for this group.
380       *
381       * <p>
382       * Existing values are overwritten.
383       *
384       * <p>
385       * The {@link Inherit} class can be used to insert existing entries in this group into the position specified.
386       *
387       * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
388       * <p class='bjava'>
389       *    SerializerSet.Builder <jv>builder</jv> = SerializerSet.<jsm>create</jsm>();  <jc>// Create an empty builder.</jc>
390       *
391       *    <jv>builder</jv>.set(FooSerializer.<jk>class</jk>);  <jc>// Now contains:  [FooSerializer]</jc>
392       *
393       *    <jv>builder</jv>.set(BarSerializer.<jk>class</jk>, BazSerializer.<jk>class</jk>);  <jc>// Now contains:  [BarParser,BazSerializer]</jc>
394       *
395       *    <jv>builder</jv>.set(Inherit.<jk>class</jk>, QuxSerializer.<jk>class</jk>);  <jc>// Now contains:  [BarParser,BazSerializer,QuxSerializer]</jc>
396       * </p>
397       *
398       * @param values The serializers to set in this group.
399       * @return This object.
400       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If one or more values do not extend from {@link Serializer} or named <js>"Inherit"</js>.
401       */
402      public Builder set(Class<?>...values) {
403         List<Object> l = list();
404         for (var e : values) {
405            if (e.getSimpleName().equals(CLASS_Inherit)) {
406               l.addAll(entries);
407            } else if (Serializer.class.isAssignableFrom(e)) {
408               l.add(createBuilder(e));
409            } else {
410               throw rex("Invalid type passed to SerializeGroup.Builder.set(): %s", cn(e));
411            }
412         }
413         entries = l;
414         return this;
415      }
416
417      @Override /* Overridden from Object */
418      public String toString() {
419         return entries.stream().map(this::toString).collect(joining(",", "[", "]"));
420      }
421
422
423      private <T extends Serializer.Builder<?>> Stream<T> builders(Class<T> type) {
424         return entries.stream().filter(type::isInstance).map(type::cast);
425      }
426
427      private Object copyBuilder(Object o) {
428         if (o instanceof Serializer.Builder<?> x) {
429            Serializer.Builder<?> x2 = x.copy();
430            if (neq(x.getClass(), x2.getClass()))
431               throw rex("Copy method not implemented on class %s", cn(x));
432            x = x2;
433            if (nn(bcBuilder))
434               x.marshallingContext(bcBuilder);
435            return x;
436         }
437         return o;
438      }
439
440      private Object createBuilder(Object o) {
441         if (o instanceof Class<?> o2) {
442
443            // Check for no-arg constructor.
444            var ci = info(o2).getPublicConstructor(c -> c.getParameterCount() == 0).orElse(null);
445            if (nn(ci))
446               return ci.newInstance();
447
448            // Check for builder create method.
449            @SuppressWarnings({
450               "unchecked" // Type erasure requires unchecked casts
451            })
452            Serializer.Builder<?> b = Serializer.createSerializerBuilder((Class<? extends Serializer>)o);
453            if (nn(bcBuilder))
454               b.marshallingContext(bcBuilder);
455            o = b;
456         }
457         return o;
458      }
459
460      private String toString(Object o) {
461         if (o == null)
462            return "null";
463         if (o instanceof Serializer.Builder<?>)
464            return "builder:" + cn(o);
465         return "serializer:" + cn(o);
466      }
467
468      /**
469       * Builds the serializer set.
470       *
471       * @return A new {@link SerializerSet}.
472       */
473      public SerializerSet build() {
474         if (nn(impl))
475            return impl;
476         return new SerializerSet(this);
477      }

521   // Maps Accept headers to matching serializers.
522   private final ConcurrentHashMap<String,SerializerMatch> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
523
524   private final MediaRange[] mediaRanges;
525   private final List<MediaRange> mediaRangesList;
526   private final Serializer[] mediaTypeRangeSerializers;
527
528   private final MediaType[] mediaTypes;
529   private final List<MediaType> mediaTypesList;
530   final Serializer[] entries;
531   private final List<Serializer> entriesList;
532
533   /**
534    * Constructor.
535    *
536    * @param builder The builder for this bean.
537    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
538    */
539   protected SerializerSet(Builder builder) {
540
541      this.entries = builder.entries.stream().map(this::build).toArray(Serializer[]::new);
542      this.entriesList = u(l(entries));
543
544      List<MediaRange> lmtr = list();
545      Set<MediaType> lmt = set();
546      List<Serializer> l = list();
547      for (var e : entries) {
548         e.getMediaTypeRanges().forEachRange(x -> {
549            lmtr.add(x);
550            l.add(e);
551         });
552         e.forEachAcceptMediaType(lmt::add);
553      }
554
555      this.mediaRanges = lmtr.toArray(new MediaRange[lmtr.size()]);
556      this.mediaRangesList = u(l(mediaRanges));
557      this.mediaTypes = lmt.toArray(new MediaType[lmt.size()]);
558      this.mediaTypesList = u(l(mediaTypes));
559      this.mediaTypeRangeSerializers = l.toArray(new Serializer[l.size()]);
560   }
561

563    * Creates a copy of this serializer group.
564    *
565    * @return A new copy of this serializer group.
566    */
567   public Builder copy() {
568      return new Builder(this);
569   }

571   /**
572    * Same as {@link #getSerializerMatch(MediaType)} but returns just the matched serializer.
573    *
574    * @param mediaType The HTTP media type.
575    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns {@link Optional#empty()}).
576    * @return The serializer that matched the accept header, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no match was made.
577    */
578   public Optional<Serializer> getSerializer(MediaType mediaType) {
579      return getSerializerMatch(mediaType).map(SerializerMatch::getSerializer);
580   }
581
582   /**
583    * Same as {@link #getSerializerMatch(String)} but returns just the matched serializer.
584    *
585    * @param acceptHeader The HTTP <l>Accept</l> header string.
586    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns {@link Optional#empty()}).
587    * @return The serializer that matched the accept header, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no match was made.
588    */
589   public Optional<Serializer> getSerializer(String acceptHeader) {
590      return getSerializerMatch(acceptHeader).map(SerializerMatch::getSerializer);
591   }
592
593   /**
594    * Same as {@link #getSerializerMatch(String)} but matches using a {@link MediaType} instance.
595    *
596    * @param mediaType The HTTP media type.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns {@link Optional#empty()}).
597    * @return The serializer and media type that matched the media type, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no match was made.
598    */
599   public Optional<SerializerMatch> getSerializerMatch(MediaType mediaType) {
600      return mediaType == null ? oe() : getSerializerMatch(mediaType.toString());
601   }
602
603   /**
604    * Searches the group for a serializer that can handle the specified <c>Accept</c> value.
605    *
606    * <p>
607    * The <c>accept</c> value complies with the syntax described in RFC2616, Section 14.1, as described below:
608    * <p class='bcode'>
609    *    Accept         = "Accept" ":"
610    *                      #( media-range [ accept-params ] )
611    *
612    *    media-range    = ( "*\/*"
613    *                      | ( type "/" "*" )
614    *                      | ( type "/" subtype )
615    *                      ) *( ";" parameter )
616    *    accept-params  = ";" "q" "=" qvalue *( accept-extension )
617    *    accept-extension = ";" token [ "=" ( token | quoted-string ) ]
618    * </p>
619    *
620    * <p>
621    * The returned object includes both the serializer and media type that matched.
622    *
623    * @param acceptHeader The HTTP <l>Accept</l> header string.
624    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns {@link Optional#empty()}).
625    * @return The serializer and media type that matched the accept header, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no match was made.
626    */
627   public Optional<SerializerMatch> getSerializerMatch(String acceptHeader) {
628      if (acceptHeader == null)
629         return oe();
630      SerializerMatch sm = cache.get(acceptHeader);
631      if (nn(sm))
632         return o(sm);
633
634      var a = MediaRanges.of(acceptHeader);
635      int match = a.match(mediaRangesList);
636      if (match >= 0) {
637         sm = new SerializerMatch(mediaRanges[match], mediaTypeRangeSerializers[match]);
638         cache.putIfAbsent(acceptHeader, sm);
639      }
640
641      return o(cache.get(acceptHeader));
642   }
643

651   /**
652    * Same as {@link #getSerializer(MediaType)}, but casts it to a {@link OutputStreamSerializer}.
653    *
654    * @param mediaType The HTTP media type.
655    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns {@link Optional#empty()}).
656    * @return The serializer that matched the accept header, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no match was made.
657    */
658   public Optional<OutputStreamSerializer> getStreamSerializer(MediaType mediaType) {
659      return getSerializer(mediaType).map(OutputStreamSerializer.class::cast);
660   }

662   /**
663    * Same as {@link #getSerializer(String)}, but casts it to an {@link OutputStreamSerializer}.
664    *
665    * @param acceptHeader The HTTP <l>Accept</l> header string.
666    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns {@link Optional#empty()}).
667    * @return The serializer that matched the accept header, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no match was made.
668    */
669   public Optional<OutputStreamSerializer> getStreamSerializer(String acceptHeader) {
670      return getSerializer(acceptHeader).map(OutputStreamSerializer.class::cast);
671   }
672
673   /**
674    * Returns the media types that all serializers in this group can handle.
675    *
676    * <p>
677    * Entries are ordered in the same order as the serializers in the group.
678    *
679    * @return An unmodifiable list of media types.
680    */
681   public List<MediaType> getSupportedMediaTypes() { return mediaTypesList; }
682
683   /**
684    * Same as {@link #getSerializer(MediaType)}, but casts it to a {@link WriterSerializer}.
685    *
686    * @param mediaType The HTTP media type.
687    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns {@link Optional#empty()}).
688    * @return The serializer that matched the accept header, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no match was made.
689    */
690   public Optional<WriterSerializer> getWriterSerializer(MediaType mediaType) {
691      return getSerializer(mediaType).map(WriterSerializer.class::cast);
692   }
693
694   /**
695    * Same as {@link #getSerializer(String)}, but casts it to a {@link WriterSerializer}.
696    *
697    * @param acceptHeader The HTTP <l>Accept</l> header string.
698    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns {@link Optional#empty()}).
699    * @return The serializer that matched the accept header, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no match was made.
700    */
701   public Optional<WriterSerializer> getWriterSerializer(String acceptHeader) {
702      return getSerializer(acceptHeader).map(WriterSerializer.class::cast);
703   }
704
705   /**
706    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if this group contains no serializers.
707    *
708    * @return <jk>true</jk> if this group contains no serializers.
709    */
710   public boolean isEmpty() { return entries.length == 0; }
711
712   private Serializer build(Object o) {
713      if (o instanceof Serializer o2)
714         return o2;
715      return ((Serializer.Builder<?>)o).build();
716   }
717}
